model.name: T-ios-all-types-open-drawer: on iOS, all file types (not just vcard) must open the ContentPreviewer drawer
model.description: R19.87 fix (iOS-specific): on iPhone Safari/PWA only text/vcard files open the ContentPreviewer drawer; image/html/url/webitem do not (works on desktop). Likely iOS touch-event delegation (click vs touchend, passive listeners, 300ms tap delay) on the file-item click handler. Restore drawer-open for ALL content types on iOS. Verify on real iPhone Safari + PWA. Singular-chain: ONE UseCase per Task; ONE Method per UseCase (learning #27). Architect to design the UC.
